scope: Bounded discovery of Slovak official legal publication, EU/EEA/Swiss free movement and third-country family residence, visa and mission guidance, administrative procedure and remedies, family-status evidence, privacy, oversight, legal aid and court-search routes. Not a complete national inventory or a legal-equivalence opinion.
retrieval_status: 31 candidate texts converted; 15 Slov-Lex legal texts plus 15 binding PDFs and 11 linked annex PDFs captured; eight MFA requests returned HTTP 403; the official static archive index was identified but local exact-byte capture remains pending a workspace DNS retry; no source accepted

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU free-movement residence regulation and official guidance
comparison_seed.relationship_note: Act 404/2011 is a broad Slovak immigration statute and only a partial functional match. Its general member-state definition includes EU, EEA and Swiss states but §§30 and 51–57 narrow it to EU Member States. No legal equivalence is asserted.

previous_findings_carried_forward: Prior Denmark-to-Sweden/Finland and country-expansion results are leads, not evidence of Slovak coverage or equivalent law.
Carry Czechia forward as a reminder to prefer stable date-bound official documents when a public API is absent, while verifying publisher reuse terms separately.
Carry Poland and Hungary forward: API documentation, public access and legal-text reuse rights are distinct questions; inspect exact terms before automated acquisition.
Search law, operational guidance, forms, visa and mission practice, procedure, file access, remedies, family-status evidence, privacy, oversight, legal aid and courts separately.
